items.title: Is Micron's Record Margin Squeezing Apple And HP?
items.summary: Micron Technology makes the memory chips inside PCs, phones and servers. Its gross margin is the share of sales left after the direct cost of making its chips. That margin hit 86.8% in the three months to Sep 3, 2026. It was 44.7% a year earlier, so it rose 42.1 points. It is the highest in our quarterly data back to March 2015.
